additional_info.subject: 0430554 - ID0430554-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP/T2170004373] Power Converter error CRM:00314000202
additional_info.body:
Buongiorno Valerio,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0430554.
The ticket was related to the E17 on the 40kW power converters from Atac Rome.
As you know, in the past weeks the topic has been escalated to R&D and QM for further analysis. Let me provide you with a status update:
From R&D side, contacts with the manufacturer revealed that the shutdown is caused by a communication failure between the converter and the charger. T
he current implementation is, that a communication loss to the converter is set from the charger after 30s without any CAN message received, while the converter already enters this state after 10s. A
PLC timeout of 8s will be set, and the problem could be solved. This new setting will be included in
v8.1.X.
From QM side, power converters shipped back to Factory are sent to the manufacturers for further quality analysis.
At the moment, the instructions are to replace the power converter if E17 appears permanently, or several times. From v8.1.X, a better detection of the issue will be implemented in the FW, enabling us to identify exactly the faulty power converters.
Investigation under a quality point of view with the manufacturer is still ongoing, therefore, please open a ticket if new power converters are found with E17 and include QM in the ticket. It is important to track all the cases in ISP and to follow QM instructions (such as, ship the faulty converters to Factory, so to be sent to the manufacturer for analysis).
Further information on the status of the analysis with the manufacturer will be shared by Product Care via official channels and by Product Champion in periodic meetings.
Since we have no further pending actions from service side, I will proceed to close this ticket.
Thank you again for the collaboration and support!
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
